correctness.rationale: The algebraic product gives the coordinatewise commutation equations. Translation-label cases partition exhaustively into identity, one-zero, equal nonzero, and independent nonzero pairs. Their coset factors are 4 per point, 10 per two-element orbit, and 58 per four-element orbit, with the last proved by an exact F2 rank distribution 1,9,6. The quotient correction compares all empty-labeled pair duplications. Explicit finite checks confirm the formulas for groups of orders 2,4,8 and direct multiplication for orders 2,4; the all-rank claim rests on the proof rather than those checks.

value.rationale: The full ordered-commuting-pair invariant for a natural infinite family of Boolean translation inverse monoids and the zero-collapsed partial translation quotient receives an exact formula and interpretable orbit constants. It yields the asymptotic n^{-2} commuting degree and exponentially dominant idempotent pairs, neither implied by the ambient commuting-graph diameter or general Howson-property results. This extends the structure theory of regular partial group actions beyond an arbitrary finite example.
